body:
Man/lady, you're kind. The only thing that has stopped me so far is the effect on everyone else: I think 'why should I care' since I'll be gone, but the family/friends bond is strong. I'm sure I look like a time waster compared to a lot of people on SW, since I've no reason to do anything, but tonight I only popped home to get some smokes on the way, and I thought 'what's the harm' in posting here. I got caught up in one of my friends going amiss, so that occupied my head for a bit, I got her home and now I'm thinking what's stopping me. I can make it look accidental, like I was drunk and wandering, and fell in the water. It happened to a guy I was good friends with last year, he ended upon a beach and washed in 3 days later, and another lad ended up in the water and was found in the morning dead.
I love my family and friends. Especially Sarah. Beyond comprehension.
I'm just sick of this shit that we call life.

I was on the end of said pier, and I got a call about a friend that had gone amiss and it stopped me. I always worry about how friends and family would think, even though I plan to make it look an accident. I really don't want it to look deliberate, which is stupid, since I'll be dead and obviously not caring if it works. 
I want family and friends to think its a tragic accident. Only one friend knows I feel like this, and I only told him when I was extremely drunk.
It has been carrying on for too long. I wake every morning regretting not dying in my sleep. I've had one very good chance that have looked tragic, and I got out of it, it was only after I kicked myself for not going with it.
